datasets.name: GF-2 satellite remote sensing image
datasets.verbatim: The remote sensing image was captured by the GF-2 satellite on 10 September 2022

datasets.name: DEM data
datasets.verbatim: DEM data downloaded from NASA (https://search.asf.alaska.edu, accessed on 2 January 2024) were provided by Japan’s Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS).

datasets.name: Pixel-level landslide inventory
datasets.verbatim: The pixel-level landslide inventory utilized for training and testing was obtained through manual interpretation

methods.name: Landslide recognition method based on multiple ML techniques and terrain feature fusion
methods.summary: The method involves extracting remote sensing features (spectral, texture, and thematic indices) and terrain features (DEM-derived) to construct a multidimensional feature set. It then trains five machine learning algorithms (XGBoost, AdaBoost, LightGBM, RF, and CNN) using different positive/negative sample ratios to identify landslides at the pixel level.
methods.source: Jincan Wang, Zhiheng Wang, Liyao Peng, and Chenzhihao Qian
methods.verbatim: This study... proposes a landslide recognition method based on multiple ML techniques and terrain feature fusion.

availability.author_statement: The authors have not obtained permission to publish the data. Therefore, the data can be obtained from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code lacks a repository or persistent link.
